gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham packs its lowercase tight up against the capital line, like chalk on a board, with the inside of each c easy to spot. And Edo SZ stands over it with cast-iron stature and one constant stroke, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Tai Viet, with its tall x-height, short ascenders and terminals pulled back from the curves; Edo SZ sits above it. Give that body a little extra size.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed and rides high at the waist, a plain sans under Edo SZ. Its slim joins and that display weight meet in sharp contrast.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Edo SZ draws a cast-iron lowercase in a single constant stroke, much like a plotter pen would. Noto Sans Tamil follows looking magnified without any size change, its terminals stopping well away from the stem, so a long passage feels generous and unhurried.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads stocky, its round forms like open parentheses inside a middle band so tall it fills the line. Its sturdy build lets a long stretch of text feel steady and dense.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Edo SZ looks like bent paperclip wire, one constant stroke with no thick-to-thin shifts, topped by cast-iron stature. Noto Sans Tangsa is a plain sans with wide, inviting round letters beneath it, and that softness is the pairing's best trait.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads wide open, with large counters and curves that flare outward. Edo SZ is best at looping, tubing-like strokes that command attention with classic stature, while the sans-serif body is best at quietly carrying the words.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Wire-bright and old-fashioned at once, Edo SZ glows with a thickness like neon glass tubing. Noto Sans Telugu sets a high midline beneath it and keeps its counters connected to the outside, which gives the pair a crisp, grounded finish.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Approachable describes Noto Sans Thaana, with wide channels leading into each counter and big open lowercase forms. And Edo SZ, drawn like a wire, gives that plain sans a sturdy cast-iron partner above it.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-thai: Approachable and a bit puffed up, Noto Sans Thai swells like inflated glass beads. Edo SZ's fat crossbars, as heavy as its stems, give that roundness a solid cast-iron anchor on the page.
